summary: Evaxion A/S, a Danish clinical-stage TechBio company listed on Nasdaq under EVAX, filed a Form 6-K on September 14, 2026 furnishing a press release announcing expansion of its AI-Immunology platform into autoimmune diseases, an internal R&D and pipeline milestone rather than a transactional event. No stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or ownership mechanics are stated. Initial experimental data on two novel treatment concepts will be presented at PEGS Europe in Lisbon on November 18, 2026. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
